articles.description: Nagpur Metro is constructing a 257-metre-long elevated bridge nearly 80 feet above railway tracks at Uppalwadi as part of its Phase-II expansion. The project is part of the 6.92-km Reach-2A corridor towards Kamptee.

articles.title: Caught On Camera: Gujarat Man Sets Neighbour's Car On Fire Over Repeated Sensor Noise, Films Blaze; Video Goes Viral
articles.description: In Gujarat's Morbi, a man named Shikhar Gohel allegedly set a lawyer's parked Maruti Suzuki Swift on fire out of irritation over its continuously beeping car sensor. The accused poured petrol on the vehicle, set it ablaze, and recorded the incident on his mobile phone before leaving.
